bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) on specialized VQA datasets (e.g., TDIUC, TallyQA) that include 'absurd' questions and complex counting tasks to prevent models from achieving high accuracy by relying solely on linguistic correlations without processing visual evidence.

Testing models on datasets designed to eliminate spurious correlations and dataset quirks, such as VQDv1 (requiring multiple bounding boxes rather than single-object referring expressions) and DVQA (using synthetic charts requiring OCR instead of predictable natural images).
